ALGER, lundi 29 juin 2026 (APS) — Le min: ALGIERS, Monday, June 29, 2026 (APS) — The Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research, Kamel Baddari, received a delegation from Jade University (Germany) at the headquarters of his ministry. The meeting is part of a partnership with the University of Algiers 1 for a dual degree program aimed at Algerian and German students.
La délégation allemande, conduite par so: The German delegation, led by its president Prof. Manfred Weisensee, was accompanied by two vice-presidents and three deans. A ministry press release states that this agreement also aims to strengthen academic and scientific cooperation between the two institutions.
L’accord prévoit l’organisation d’événem: The agreement provides for the organization of joint scientific events in precision specialties, as well as an increase in the mobility of teachers and students from both countries.
Le projet s’ajoute aux initiatives visan: The project adds to initiatives aimed at developing international university exchanges under the aegis of the Algerian ministry.
